steps.code:
# Fetch all pages of sent transactions with query "electricity" within the year.
all_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        query="electricity",
        min_created_at="2023-01-01",
        max_created_at="2023-05-18",
        direction="sent",
        page_limit=20,
        page_index=page_index
    )
    if not page:
        break
    all_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Filter transactions with "electricity" in description (case-insensitive)
electricity_txns = [t for t in all_transactions if 'electricity' in t['description'].lower()]
print(f"Found {len(electricity_txns)} electricity transactions")
for t in electricity_txns:
    print(t['transaction_id'], t['amount'], t['description'], t['created_at'])

total = sum(t['amount'] for t in electricity_txns)
print(f"Total: {total}")
